description: This file defines the Border class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for managing border styles and colors in spreadsheet cells, including methods for applying styles and retrieving style components.

classes.name: Border
classes.description: Represents the style and color of a cell border, including methods for style application, color management, and style sharing mechanisms within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a Border object, optionally as a supervisor or conditional style.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared style component for the current cell border, used mainly when the object is a style supervisor.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and returns an array of style attributes from subcomponents.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies style settings from an array to the border object, affecting active sheet style if a supervisor.

methods.name: getBorderStyle
methods.description: Returns the current border style, possibly from a shared component if supervisor.

methods.name: setBorderStyle
methods.description: Sets the border style, accepting string or boolean values, with special handling for supervisor objects.

methods.name: getColor
methods.description: Returns the Color object representing the border color.

methods.name: setColor
methods.description: Sets the border color using a Color object.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code representing the current style state, accounting for supervisor status.
